newsitem.title: USA: KV Pharmaceutical launches Roche drug.
newsitem.headline: KV Pharmaceutical launches Roche drug.

text.p: KV Pharmaceutical Co said Thursday its subsidiary ETHEX Corp has introduced a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug that is a generic alternative to Toradol marketed by Roche Laboratories Inc.
This is the first of the products KV will be marketing in a partnership agreement reached with Swiss pharmaceuticals group Roche Holding Ltd.
Toradol tablets generated more than $44.9 million in sales in 1996, according to industry estimates. The drug is used for the short-term management of moderately severe acute pain.

KV develops, makes and markets controlled-release, site specific and tastemasked forms of drug products using proprietary drug delivery and tastemaking technologies. ETHEX makes generic pharmaceuticals.
